We'll try to cover all the development news by posting new devlogs on the full game page instead, so make sure to follow us there and wishlist it! 😇

A smaller update that fixes some of the performance issues, crashes and bugs is also here. Hopefully this patch should finalize our work on Prologue, making it more stable. Once again, we're always happy to hear about your feedback, impressions and ideas!

Be sure to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/shotxstudio]Twitter[/url] for updates and join our community on [url=https://discord.gg/T9qv7sB]Discord[/url] for sneak peeks and share your feedback!

notes.title: The Rebirth Update Pt. II - v.0.7.5.9
notes.content:
Happy New Year! 😍

We've got one more reason to celebrate because we're rolling out part two of The Rebirth update! This update puts the finishing touches on all the stuff that needed a little extra shine in Act I and sets the stage for the awesome things coming our way. 🎉

[h2]Different Tier Equipment & Inventory Changes[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cAxjz9B.gif[/img]

We've laid the groundwork for item tier system before, but with this update we're now introducing it properly - that means less boring loot and more legendary stuff! All existing equipment can now be found from common variants to uncommon, rare, epic or even legendary. With higher randomized stats the higher the tier is and more sockets for weapon mods.

With the proper introduction of the tier system, we also needed a better way to show and distinguish the tiers, so we ended up with changing the border glow with colors to indicate it.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jV39zc2.gif[/img]

More inventory improvements include the new quick-compare function that auto pops up in case you're trying to compare different equipment to already equipped ones. And finally, you can now hold CTRL to move whole stacks at once, whether you're selling, buying, or looting.

[h2]New Enemies & Combat Improvements[/h2]

Encountering the same type of enemies hundreds of times is without a doubt boring and while we're planning to really increase that numbers with Act II, we decided to add more for Act I as well. We've added 3 new bandit enemies: Meat, Zan, Bandito and 2 new zombie enemies: Spitter and Crawler.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vLD7gmx.gif[/img]

After a few playthroughs it was also noticable that players could easily take advantage of high-attack deck builds that allowed for quick finishing all the existing enemy types in round 1, before enemies even having a chance to perform their moves. To counter this, we've introduced a function for enemies to start combat with buffs, e.g. some enemies might now have a guard effect applied which would mean that player'd have to take damage if they were to attack that specific enemy. Besides that, we've also increased the starting block amount for different enemies and overall, we think these changes should make combat encounters much more interesting. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/k3PYmHp.png[/img]

We also recreated all the enemy intention icons to be more intuitive, fitting and decided for mixed intention to also show the according values for both attack and defense.

[h2]New Weapon Mods & Caravan Parts[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/iYxMDca.png[/img]

There's a rumor going on that traders brought in a whole lot of new caravan parts and weapon modifications to settlements! That's right, you'll now have an option to choose between different part manufacturers, with each promising their own positives and negatives. There's a total of 48 new different parts to choose from in Act I, so the time has come to upgrade your caravan for real this time.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4TEf231.png[/img]

As for weapon modifications, there are now 13 new items that can further improve your deadly weapons to slay through the hordes with ease. From blade tips and handles to rifle barrels and sights!

[h2]Rebalanced Cards, Shops, Workshops, Training Grounds & More[/h2]

After some major changes, it was time to rebalance things once again and we've gone through it all. Combat cards were tweaked to make them more fitting for being starter cards as opposed to more powerful ones that you may find later in the game.

Shops, workshops, market stalls were changed to spread the available items in a better way. Training grounds were also changed to provide more variations in cards between different settlements.

We've also adjusted enemy levels in different areas, tweaked XP that's gained and improved the level up formula. You can also except some other minor changes in balance throughout the game, which hopefully will all result in a more enjoyable experience.

[h2]Dismantling Rework[/h2]

Dismantling was originally intended to be much more useful and we've reworked the whole thing to make sure it's indeed useful this time. First of all, it will now require passing of time to proceed with dismantling. This was a change that was absolutely necessary for us to introduce a new type of items - a bunch of junk, that holds no value by itself but if taken time to dismantle it, you can end up with a lot of useful random materials.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wgjZd19.gif[/img]

We've also gone through all the existing items to make sure as many of them can now be dismantled into something useful at least!

[h2]Crafting Rework[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tbGPAHl.png[/img]

Next up, we've reworked crafting to make it more useful as well. You'll now find plenty of unique recipes for special equipment such as Apocalypse Denim Jacket and Monster Pipe that can only be acquired by crafting.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cdgQHsW.png[/img]

To make things a lot more interesting, we've also decided to add special type of extra crafting materials that can't be bought anywhere, but instead can be dropped as loot during combat encounters.

More useful recipes will now available right from the beginning of the game including being able to craft bandages and ammo. Libraries also stocked up on available recipes, so make sure to check them out.

In total, we've added 17 new crafting recipes!

[h2]Cooking Rework[/h2]

As for our final polish regarding cooking - we've rebalanced all the recipes that are available in libraries, you'll now find plenty of them. Though not all recipes can be bought, so exploring every room and corner can now get you some special recipes as well.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jfCekCj.png[/img]

You'll also notice that a broader choice of recipes is now accessible right from the start. Despite Angel not necessarily fitting the typical culinary profile, he does possess the know-how to whip up some basic meals, at the very least! 😉

[h2]Seperate Attribute Points & Changes To Level Up[/h2]

This was a major change that we felt was much needed and has also been mentioned by our players as well, so we decided to separate current skill points into attribute points and combat skill points. With each level up you'll now get 1 attribute point and 2 combat skill points to spend.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/VfqRRpD.gif[/img]

You'll also get ability points every 2 levels instead of 3. Max attribute levels are set to 12 and combat skill levels to 20. The formula that calculates the XP needed for next level ups has also been reworked to make it so that it actually gets more difficult to level up as you progress, but keeping just the right balance so it doesn't require too much grind.

[h2]Lost & Found[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0UTKHkd.png[/img]

Lost & Found is a new feature that we had to introduce to deal with some annoying issues that would result due to having no free inventory slots. You could always free up space in your inventory and return back to a specific cube to loot from anytime you wanted, but in case of quest rewards or combat rewards, items could get lost with no way of getting them back.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GCZcG3X.gif[/img]

Lost & Found can be accessed at anytime now and it will auto save all the items that were rewarded, but couldn't be retrieved at that time.

So, you can now go ahead and fight as many zombies as you want with a full inventory, without the fear of missing out any valuable items!

[h2]Fixed Plus Randomized Loot[/h2]

Before Part II of The Rebirth update every lootable cube had fixed loot that we set up manually in order to make sure there was a good level of balance kept, but we always wanted to have some extra random loot too, so that not all playthroughs would be the same.

We came up with a solution that combines the best from the both worlds, fixed plus randomized loot. Each cube can now be created with a variable set to control the random loot amount, level, etc. So that there's always a chance to find something great without keeping things out of balance. 

[h2]Important Changes[/h2]

There are some other major changes that we thought was necessary once again and we'll try to cover them all here.

[h3]Silhouettes At Camp[/h3]

Some of you have mentioned that it acted as some kind of spoiler that you could see silhouettes of locked survivors right from the start. We also agreed, but since it required a major code rewrite, we couldn't do it sooner.

[h3]Equipping Same Type of Weapons[/h3]

You could previously equip the same type of weapons for both primary and secondary options without suffering any penalties. This could result in an unintended and unfair edge even in the beginning stage of the game.

We decided to reduce the attack power by -65% for the secondary slot if the player is dual wielding and calculate the average of other stats such as accuracy. 

[h3]Radar/Minimap Improvements[/h3]

Radar's been improved too - it can now show you if you're in a safe zone or not. If not, it will also display the total number of enemies in the scanning radius and the threat level (expected enemy levels) of the current area.

[h3]More Helpful Journal Tips[/h3]

We've added lots of new helpful journal tips and made sure to cover all aspects of gameplay mechanics. So, new players shouldn't be as confused anymore.

[h3]Enemy Sound Effects[/h3]

Finally, combat is no longer silent when it comes to enemy's turn. We've added fresh new sfx to fit each type of enemy.

[h3]Supply Burn Rate[/h3]

Supply burn rate will now increase with each new team member added.

[h3]Reworked Chained Enemies[/h3]

Chained enemies should now indicate more enemy waves and a tougher battle, they are also easier to spot with changed icons and now link to actual parent enemy.

[h2]Thank You![/h2]

Thank you again to all of you for your support, feedback, suggestions and patience! Make sure to read the changelog, and if you manage to come across a bug that's not listed here, please do report it to us! 😇

[b]NOTE REGARDING THIS UPDATE: Because of some major changes, the update will erase older version save files automatically.[/b]

Have fun! 🥳

If you enjoy playing the prologue, please consider wishlisting the full game on Steam! 🥰

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2393580/The_Dead_Await

Be sure to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/shotxstudio]Twitter[/url] for updates and join our community on [url=https://discord.gg/T9qv7sB]Discord[/url] for sneak peeks and share your feedback!

notes.title: The Rebirth Update - v.0.7.0.0
notes.content:
Welcome back, survivors! 💪

We know, we know... we've gone into radio silence for a while now, but we've been working hard on TDA. The wait is finally over now and we've prepared another big update for you - The Rebirth Update (v.0.7.0.0).

We've taken notes of all your feedback, suggestions, ideas then mixed them with our own and turned it into a one huge update. 

[h2]Discovery Bonus[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818348/c0cb13ee7ddd7a2148d72e0eb7685e33e8d2fc95.png[/img]

Cooking during the zombie apocalypse is a blast, but you know what would make it even more awesome? If every time you whip up a new recipe, you get some cool, permanent bonuses. That's where the Discovery Bonus comes in – giving you extra perks to enjoy.

Just go through all the recipes and cook each one to score some sweet, permanent stat boosts. It's not just about surviving; it's about rocking it in the camp amid all the zombie craziness. So, let's turn those canned goods into tasty treats and enjoy the bonuses that come with each new dish.

Get ready to spice up your cooking game! 🍕

[h2]Localization[/h2]

We've laid the groundwork for localization, did a bunch of hard work, and now every bit of text is directly linked to localized functions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818348/66bb1d5dec175c3c8efbf3e67e589a8109b6cb2e.png[/img]

We're extremely happy and excited to announce that our prologue is now available in both Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.

[h2]New Quests, NPCs & Locations[/h2]

We've been super busy these past few months getting all the cool stuff for Act I ready. And guess what? It's all set and we're so excited for you to check it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818348/c9904041f0b47772ebfc012c6d11bf179d9a1fb2.png[/img]

We've thrown in 10 brand new quests, introduced 12 new characters to the story, and dropped 9 fresh locations – all in Act I! Enjoy the adventure!

[h2]More Cubes & Items[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818348/0a0a39499bc256596251caa7080fe045bb0cf9ab.png[/img]

While we were busy crafting new spots to explore, we didn't stop at just creating locations. We went the extra mile and designed more than 25 new cubes to make each place feel extra unique. So, you'll notice a bunch of different styles and vibes as you venture through the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818348/caf7fcc3bb17b47543f9ea624963e6b96df96caa.png[/img]

And here's the really exciting part – with all these new additions, the grand total of items you can find and use in Act I has soared to over 250! That's a whole bunch of things waiting for you to discover and use on your adventure.

[h2]PCs & Hacking[/h2]

We've introduced a new feature – now you can mess around with a new kind of cube - PCs. With these, you can dig through files to find interesting stuff like notes or images. Plus, you can fiddle with other electronic gadgets connected to the same network. Fancy opening locks from a distance? Yep, you can do that too!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/03fcEeP.gif[/img]

But wait, some of these PCs might be locked up tight. You'll need Access Cards to log in, or if you're feeling like a cyberninja, you can use your hacking skills to break into the system. 

[h2]DoF, Improved Transitions & New Options[/h2]

We've thrown in some awesome new visual details, like Depth of Field that makes everything look super cool. And yes, we've also improved how you move between places and game modes – it's smoother now.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/R7tIDSQ.gif[/img]

And the best part? You can mess around with all these changes! Tweak them the way you want in the options menu. We even added some other cool options, like mouse lock. So, go ahead, make the game look and feel just the way you like it!

[h2]New Events[/h2]

Get ready for some new stuff happening in TDA! Now, besides the random events that just pop up, we've tossed in some local events too. These events are all fixed and happen once interacted with cubes - then our event and action feature kicks in.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xIHuyAS.gif[/img]

Finish up these local events, and you'll snag yourself some special rewards. It's like a little bonus for getting things done!                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                

[h2]...And More![/h2]

[i]Oh yeah, and when we say more, we mean a whole bunch more! So, go ahead, grab your favorite drink and settle in for some added excitement.[/i]

[h3]Refreshed Audio & Extended OST[/h3]

We played around with the sounds to make them cooler, threw in some fresh effects to spice things up, and made our awesome soundtrack even longer. Now, it all sounds better than ever!

[h3]Tons of Bug Fixes & Adjustments[/h3]

Most importantly, we tackled a bunch of annoying bugs, crashes, and blockers that were causing trouble. After some serious fixing, we made the gameplay a whole lot smoother. Now, you can dive into the game without those pesky interruptions.

[h3]Balancing Changes[/h3]

After testing things out, we saw that leveling up early on was a bit too simple. So, we've made some changes to even things out. We also tweaked the balance in different parts of the game, like various stats, to make sure everything's fair and square.

[h3]More Tips![/h3]

We've added a lot of new tips to our in-game catalogue of tips, making it way better at explaining how all the game stuff works. So, you won't be scratching your head as much now!

[h3]UI Improvements[/h3]

Now, when you hover over NPCs, you'll see their names and what they're up to. We also added neat animations for new waves in combat mode and fixed up various other things related to UI.

[h2]Thank You![/h2]

Finally, we wanted to thank you all for your support, feedback, suggestions and patience! Make sure to read the changelog, and if you manage to come across a bug that's not listed here, please do report it to us! 😇

[b]NOTE REGARDING THIS UPDATE: Because of some major changes, the update will erase older version save files automatically.[/b]

Have fun! 🥳

If you enjoy the prologue, please consider wishlisting the full game on Steam! 🥰

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2393580/The_Dead_Await

Be sure to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/shotxstudio]Twitter[/url] for updates and join our community on [url=https://discord.gg/T9qv7sB]Discord[/url] for sneak peeks and share your feedback!

notes.title: Huge Update! - v.0.6.3.1
notes.content:
Greetings, survivors!

We hope you're enjoying the summer season ☀ we've been busy working on a huge update here at Shotx, to make your summer days even more awesome!

We're super excited about this update because it's our biggest one yet. We want to express our gratitude once again for all the support, feedback, and bug reports you've provided. Now, let's jump right into what's new in this update.

[h2]New Combat Cards![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818348/01d7231776f268a483b5bd205e56d5995e5bcbbb.png[/img]

Combat is a HUGE part of The Dead Await and this update brings 13 new cards for you to unlock! We've also included some extra cards that are available right from the beginning of the game.

There's "Scatterstorm" for when you need to shoot through the whole mob of zombies at once and "Bonebreaker" for - well, to crush some bones and make sure the enemy remembers it with status effects.

[h2]New Equipment & Weapons![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818348/b955d4092645acab9d8218d77253b103b4709320.png[/img]

That's right! We've also added many new weapons and equipment. Crowbar? Check. Denim jacket? Check! Umm.. a nice comfy beanie? Yep, also check!

Now you know what you're wishing for when the loot drops 😉

[h2]New NPCs & Side Quests![/h2]

We've also added new side quests along with new NPCs, some of which are also available in the Prologue version. I'm not going to spoil too much, so here's a sneak peek at what's hiding in West Bazaar!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oXIyIWC.gif[/img]

[h2]Positive Character Status Effects 😍[/h2]

Get ready for a boost of positivity with our latest character status effects! Introducing Adrenaline, Healing, Enraged, and Courage, these temporary buffs will give your character a significant stat boost. Feel the rush of Adrenaline, restore your health with Healing, unleash your inner power with Enraged, and bolster your bravery with Courage.

But that's not all! We've also introduced three new health items to aid you in your journey. Say hello to Booster, Kill Pill, and Death Drive. These items all have a chance to result in a positive status effect.

[h2]New Features![/h2]

Besides the new content mentioned above, we've also been working on some new features.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/d4Che11.gif[/img]

We've introduced a new feature that adds ownership to cubes in the game. Now, if you're near a cube that has an owner, they can interrupt your actions. For instance, if you're attempting to loot a house and the owner is present, they will intervene and prevent you from proceeding. It adds an extra layer of challenge and realism to your gameplay experience. Stay alert and be mindful of the owners!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2aiOLgs.gif[/img]

We've taken note that players who are new to card combat might feel a bit overwhelmed when playing TDA for the first time. Even after completing the tutorial, they may have some questions and uncertainties. To address this, we've made an exciting addition to the game.

Introducing the journal in combat mode! Now, players can access helpful tips and information whenever they need it. Whether you're in the midst of a challenging battle or simply looking to refine your strategy, the journal is there to assist you along the way.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/e6BIqCD.png[/img]

Another addition to the combat mode is the card hover tip. When hovering over cards with special effects, you'll now see what each effect does. We're also planning to add a new game option in the future for those who want to disable this functionality.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ccdj488.png[/img]

New cube type!? Yep!! We've introduced a new cube type that can be tied to gaining specific positive status effects. Next time you're lost in the woods, you might find spring water cube or even a wishing tree one that will result in a healing status effect being applied to your group. These cubes also have a recharge timer set, so you can't continuously keep returning to abuse it.

[h2]Important Bug Fixes[/h2]

We've gone through all the bug reports and fixed some pretty important bugs. Make sure to read the changelog, and if you manage to come across a bug that's not listed here, please do report it to us! 😇

[b]NOTE REGARDING THIS UPDATE: It's advised to start a new game because of some major changes. Loading an older version savefile might work, but may end up being bugged.[/b]

Have fun! 🥳

If you enjoy the prologue, please consider wishlisting the full game on Steam! 🥰

Be sure to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/shotxstudio]Twitter[/url] for updates and join our community on [url=https://discord.gg/T9qv7sB]Discord[/url] for sneak peeks and share your feedback!

notes.title: Devlog #9 - Feature Complete!
notes.content:
Hey all! We're a little late here with our new devlog, but we still wanted to wish you all a Happy New Year! Hope you all had amazing holidays! 🥳

We've been busy with finalizing and polishing all the features in Death Drive and we're happy to announce that we've finally reached the feature complete stage. All without sacrificing a single idea from our "cool to add features" list (and maybe even throwing in a few fresh ones).

So what does that mean? Mainly, now that we're past the headaches and suffering that usually come with the engine side of things, we're ready to unleash our full creativity on all the new content! 💪

We'll share most of our recent progress in this devlog without spoiling too much!

[h2]Event & Action System[/h2]

We've added a new feature that can be triggered by using cubes, through scripted quests or as random events. As you might have guessed by the name, the Event & Action system is basically a triggered event, that gives the player several choices affecting the outcome depending on the player's decision.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/snQvfhk.gif[/img]

Some choices will require specific skill levels, unlocked shared abilities, appropriate items, story progress or even sanity to continue.

There are 3 types of events that can occur during the gameplay:

[list]
[*] Story event - Event only occurs during scripted quests and changes the outcome of the story depending on the player's choice.
[*] World event - A type of event that is also scripted and is triggered only once that is tied to the world in Death Drive and its surroundings.
[*] Random event - A repeatable event type that is randomly triggered throughout the gameplay.
[/list]

Outcomes of certain events will affect the overall story and settlement's future. While some random events will grant player extra loot and bonuses. Though, if you're not well prepared some outcomes will result in traumas, loss of sanity and in some cases death. 💀

[h2]Finalized Item Types[/h2]

We've now finalized all the item types and as we mentioned before in our previous devlogs we really want to tell a great story and invest you into the world of Death Drive.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OHd8OWh.gif[/img]

One crucial item type that was missing before was inspectables such as notes, diaries or other similar items that tell their own stories. We also value your time and won't be filling such content with filler material, but rather only with interesting and useful content.

[h2]Wishlist Please?[/h2]

Little Billy from Sunny Village has a message for you. 😇

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fdBqper.gif[/img]

[h2]Zone 1[/h2]

We’re also ready to share some of the key locations and settlements in Zone 1. 

[h3]Sunny Village[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ml6yUOK.gif[/img]

Sunny Village was once a small, idyllic community nestled in a lush valley surrounded by rolling hills. The residents, mostly farmers and craftsmen, lived simple but happy lives, enjoying the beauty of nature and the company of their friends and neighbors. But all of that changed when the zombies came. Despite the constant threat of zombies, the people of Sunny Village have managed to maintain their way of life and their sense of community, determined to survive and thrive in this new, terrifying world.

[h3]Omega Military Base[/h3]

Omega is a heavily fortified military base created by Force Nova, that was built for training soldiers to secure the city of Hope. 
The soldiers at Omega are known for their discipline, training, and combat skills. The base is equipped with advanced technology, weapons and vehicles, and is capable of withstanding prolonged sieges. The base is also self-sufficient and can survive for long periods without resupply.

[h3]Bazaar - Traders’ Settlement[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xZHwUHQ.gif[/img]

A small city, where all the trading for food, armory, medical supplies and life essentials are happening. As the outbreak spread, Bazaar became a hub for all kinds of goods and services, as traders and merchants from all over came to barter and exchange goods. In the midst of all the chaos, Bazaar remained a place of order, a safe haven for anyone looking to trade and make a living. But the zombies were not the only threat to Bazaar, as raiders and bandits also saw the settlement as a prime target. The merchants and traders had to be constantly vigilant and they formed a powerful militia to protect their community. Therefore, not everyone can enter easily. 

[h3]Devfronds - Woodlands of Devils[/h3]

Devfronds, known as the Woodlands of Devils, is a dense and mysterious forest that has long been avoided by travelers and settlers. It is said that the woods are haunted by all manner of deadly creatures, including hordes of zombies.
	
[h3]The Mind Metropolis[/h3]
	
The Mind Metropolis is a bustling center of innovation and progress, where the brightest minds and most ambitious young people, aka The ET (The Echoes of Tomorrow) have come together to actually find solutions to the zombie apocalypse without personal side agendas. The city is a melting pot of scientists, engineers, inventors, and researchers, all working tirelessly to uncover the secrets of the virus and develop new technologies to combat the zombies. 

[h2]Share Your Feedback And Ideas![/h2]

We'd really love to hear what you think ❤

Got any crazy good ideas that you'd want to see in Death Drive? Let us know!

Stay tuned for more!

[i]We're trying to share smaller updates more frequently on our [url=https://twitter.com/shotxstudio]Twitter account[/url], so make sure you follow us! And also, you're more than welcome to join our 👉 [url=https://discord.com/invite/T9qv7sB]community on Discord[/url] 👈 and let us know what you think about Death Drive.[/i]

Stay safe!

notes.title: Devlog #8 - Shared Abilities, New Content & More
notes.content:
We're back with another devlog and this time it's special since we're also celebrating another year of working on Death Drive! 🥳 You might have been wondering what we were up to and we'll try to share all our recent progress without spoiling too much.

[h2]Shared Abilities[/h2]

Shared abilities are a variety of talents that can be used by any member of the squad. These abilities can be acquired using ability points. 

Your ability points [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818348/77312b1819df0635c37352919f52cbb667a8e9b1.png[/img] will accumulate with leveling up. 

Throughout the game, you will come across different tasks and situations where these abilities will be crucial. While some abilities will help you solve various problems, others will enhance your overall performance.

We've made huge progress already and fully completed all planned abilities that include:

[h3]Demolition[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818348/23130f118229f4b6d60ed5b7c0eefcb23ab550cf.png[/img]

[i]Demolition ability helps you use explosives that you can utilize for demolishing objects like doors, thin walls and other weak structures.[/i]

What are you going to do when the only thing stopping you from getting to that sweet stash of loot is a thin wall?

That's right! Grab some dynamite and make sure you've got the ability leveled up high enough not to blow yourself up along with that wall. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XSGY8b8.gif[/img]

[h3]Lockpicking[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818348/77a9886ec5c5a1378fe9dc6a492eab3da9cd0868.png[/img]

[i]Lockpicking ability helps you access closed premises and unlock doors, boxes and objects of different types. However, you must also have enough lockpicking kits.[/i]

Life in the apocalypse would be a lot easier if certain things weren't locked up. But with zombies running wild, you can't blame people for going an extra mile for some security; though mastering the lockpicking ability and finding usable kits will allow you to get rid of those locks for good.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8ZTWSVS.gif[/img]

After proving your lockpicking skills in this quick and fun minigame that's all about reaction time, the loot is all yours!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/y0ZtU95.gif[/img]

[h3]Hacking[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818348/ae26565be792f65a3cc63de50032147a4ddb3b5b.png[/img]

[i]Hacking ability helps you crack codes to extract valuable data from devices, gain access codes and deactivate various systems.[/i]

For better or worse, the electricity is still flowing in some parts of the world and that also means there are going to be challenges requiring the smarts. More specifically hacking your way around systems that block you otherwise.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bKi8hFA.gif[/img]

[h3]Acrobatics[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818348/ac8c76226f500ab56aaee77c5a0e388824ba11b3.png[/img]

[i]Acrobatics ability helps you access areas that are out of reach, climb the walls, jump over large ground gaps and crawl through narrow passages.[/i]

No you're not going to be using acrobatics on stage to entertain survivors or distract zombies, but then again, who knows... But, the full-on war that broke out after the infection took over left many places in ruins. Some places that used to be connected with staircases are now just large gaps and rumbles barely holding together. Spending your ability points in acrobatics is a wise choice if you're planning to tackle such challenges.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eCTprql.gif[/img]

[h3]Hunting & Fishing[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818348/323b4c8ea65efa6146af81438363cca4e4e7dcb7.png[/img]

[i]Hunting and fishing ability helps you acquire food to survive in the tough times. You will need special Hunting and Fishing equipment to be able to use this ability. Keep in mind that this activity can also be time consuming.[/i]

When you're out of your comfort zone away from the settlements, surviving gets a little harder. Luckily, you'll sometimes come across infection free wildlife and with the right tools and practice you'll soon unlock the inner predator in you.

Unlike other abilities though, hunting and fishing takes toll on your sanity and a good few hours to invest, so make sure you're well prepared for the activity!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5L3Klnq.gif[/img]

[h3]Deep Search[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818348/4ab2684048e456d8fc7c289865eb44a52ed27f05.png[/img]

[i]Deep Search ability helps you look through piles of junk and busy locations to find valuable items. You will need special Deep Search equipment to use this ability.  Keep in mind that this activity can also be time consuming. [/i]

It's not always easy to look for useful items to aid you in survival. Sometimes it takes an extra pair of good gloves and a right shovel to dig through the junk before you get to the treasure and that's when the "Deep Search" ability comes in really handy.

Similar to hunting & fishing, this ability affects your sanity and is time consuming.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eSRgNo9.gif[/img]

[h3]Defusal 101[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818348/09c6072a06a682ad49abc81e5b0f2b6fff6d02d7.png[/img]

[i]Traps are everywhere. Defusal 101 ability enables you to disarm them.[/i]

The world in Death Drive just got a lot more dangerous. We've introduced a new threat - TRAPS! And that means we've also added defusal kits and new ability specializing in disarming these traps. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WViQs64.gif[/img]

[h3]...AND MORE![/h3]

There are also some shared abilities that help with your squad's overall performance, increasing walking speed, allowing you to carry more weight and many more that we aren't going to spoil! 🤐

[h2]Blast[/h2]

We've previously shared some information regarding minigames in Taverns. Originally one of those games was planned to be Blackjack, but we kept coming up with new interesting twists and ideas. Finally, all that brainstorming resulted in something fresh and exciting - Blast! A game with just the right dose of skill and luck, and here's a sneak peek:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rqvq1xO.gif[/img]

[i]Your goal is to accumulate cards with total value higher than that of your opponent. There’s 3 types of actions for your each turn: Hit - draw a card from the deck, Power - use one of your 3 Power cards, Stand - end the drawing on your side.

You can only use power cards on the last 5 cards that are displayed on the board. The game is over if there are no more cards in the deck, both players get a Blast card (blasts 3 random cards from your current cards and you can no longer draw) or Stand. The player with higher total score wins the game.[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1xJ4wbF.gif[/img]

There's also permanent progression by unlocking new power cards!

[h2]Auto Service & Special Caravan Upgrades[/h2]

Some settlements will now feature auto service shop where you can get all the latest upgrades for your caravan. We've shared some information regarding the customization before, but we also wanted to include a new type of permanent upgrades that wouldn't alter the stats depending on the other parts. For this we added Special Upgrades.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5QFqfFi.gif[/img]

[h2]More Progress[/h2]

In other news, we're getting closer than ever to the feature complete stage and we're fully transitioning to focusing on solely new content. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818348/06f259898352813bf8ae56314c2e559279135b58.png[/img]

And finally we've got some good news for quicksave fans! 💪 We've fully completed our saving/loading system that supports auto-saving, quicksaves and manual saves. So you can save all you want without any restrictions as long as you're not in combat and there are no enemies close by.

We'd really love to hear what you think ❤

Got any crazy good ideas that you'd want to see in Death Drive? Let us know!

Stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Devlog #7 - Massive Update!
notes.content:
Hey there, fellow Death Drive passengers! 

You might have seen some sneak peeks on our social media pages, but here's long overdue devlog update we've been too eager to share with you. 

We've been working truly hard on Death Drive. (hint: almost 24/7 😉) And luckily that massive amount of work was not all about fixing those nasty bugs, but resulted in huge progress as well. So, welcome back to our devlog, survivors! 💪

[h2]Taverns![/h2]

There is a new place in settlements to relax a bit and free up your mind from all things survival, taverns! Possibly one of the best place still standing post apocalypse. Get drunk, fill up your stomach and listen in on all the latest rumors.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XlEmBrd.gif[/img]

And that's not all, we also plan to include several minigames scattered around places like these... what's a tavern without card games and some wagering to keep it spicy?!

[h2]Town Hall[/h2]

Quite often some of the more populated areas you find on your journey will have a special building dedicated to town's issues - a town hall. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818348/6599540e3be3f2bb9cb1275554bd64282cb5fd88.png[/img]

While we're still working on some other concepts to add to town halls, we can still share more about 2 complete features for now - investing in settlements and announcement boards.

[h3]Investing In Settlements[/h3]

Investing in settlements is one of the best options if you're looking for stability. With each month, you'll earn your share of revenue, a percentage of your total deposit. The percentage varies from one settlement to another and could also depend on various factors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818348/56b76ac53a24178df91fbd2c76e5e4a96e7be4a5.gif[/img]

[h3]Announcement Board[/h3]

Looking for a job? or perhaps some interesting stories surrounding the settlement. Announcement board contains all the important posts and job listings. Posts get updated monthly with both scripted and procedurally generated jobs and contracts.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bcIwOLz.gif[/img]

You'll have to pay attention to the difficulty level before accepting new jobs, some jobs might cost you more than the reward offered. Besides job posts, you'll also find different notes from other survivors, some of which could be informational and useful, while others straight up insane coming from those who've had too much.

[h3]Contracts & Jobs[/h3]

We've briefly mentioned about jobs and contracts previously and now with the announcement board ready, it's all finished from the ground up! We've also made it super easy to set up for the scripted jobs for that one time special rewards, and for procedural generation you can expect unlimited amount of jobs and contracts with different objectives. Everything from transporting goods between settlements to neutralizing bandit leaders.

[h2]Chained Enemies[/h2]

Enemies that are chained together will trigger an encounter if one of them manages to get close to you and at the same time you'll be fighting the whole group. Likewise once you kill the whole group, all of the chained enemies will disappear in world view.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ziHl5PB.gif[/img]

We wanted to portray that feeling of dread that surrounds zombie hordes in the game without triggering single encounters for each one of them and we think this was the best fitting option!

[h2]Weather System[/h2]

Survival is the key element in Death Drive and we go even deeper with the new weather system. From clear skies to fog and heavy storms it's all unpredictable and affects your travel conditions accordingly. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jL5Gbbv.gif[/img]

During heavy storms you'll get a weather alert and unless you're already camping near the settlement you won't be able to set up the camp anywhere else. Just picture you're transporting goods to your destination, barely surviving and suddenly you end up in the middle of the horde and you hear that thunder. With the heavy storm adding up to that, your caravan breaks down!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/P8yCHGF.gif[/img]

Lucky for you, we've also added emergency repair kits that allows you to repair your caravan without setting up the camp and in much less time, so make sure you always have a few of them before embarking on long journeys.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mboJONo.gif[/img]

[h2]Cooking Finalized[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818348/d486a653e07c1b033b8d57569bd03b54bbb2df01.png[/img]

There are a total of 51 unique recipes to unlock and cook now! From home made energy drinks and spaghetti to Poor Man's Sushi and Ojakhuri. Each granting different character bonuses.

With over 89 new ingredients added, we've now completed all the planned content for your cooking needs.

[h2]More Progress![/h2]

We've finally managed to recreate all of our existing art assets with the new style, including human enemies and camp, so expect to see some fresh content from now on.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/A5l5I6e.gif[/img]

We've also added long format time tracking spanning to weeks and months as some of the content will have dependency on time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818348/0516e50b39948caff120e8bf3fd22e818c8ead5a.png[/img]

And finally, we've created more variations of random NPCs that can be found in settlements and added over 20 different interactive and obstacle tiles!

[h2]Share Your Feedback And Ideas![/h2]

We'd really love to hear what you think ❤

Got any crazy good ideas that you'd want to see in Death Drive? Let us know!

Stay tuned for more!

And also, you're more than welcome to join our 👉 [url=https://discord.com/invite/T9qv7sB]community on Discord[/url] 👈 and let us know what you think about Death Drive.[/i]

Stay safe!

notes.title: Devlog #6 - Story, Cutscenes & Combat Design Overhaul
notes.content:
Hey there survivors, we're back with another devlog! 💪

Busier than ever, this month we've completely overhauled combat design, started merging the whole storyline with the intro quests, included cutscenes and Death Drive is looking better than ever!

[h2]Story & Cutscenes[/h2]

[h3]Cutscenes[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0jVJBNC.gif[/img]

We want to tell a great story and make sure our new cutscene system does the job well and sets the mood for the game. We implemented 2 different options. First, a full screen animated mode that gives you control over the pace allowing you to move on to the next scene as soon as you're done reading. And the second one, a quick scene mode to better merge with the gameplay for when the duration of the cutscene is shorter. 

 [h3]Story[/h3]

We spent quite some time refining our story and after a few tries, we got a perfect prologue complete along with the first few quests. With some new characters, settlements and rest of the content it's now starting to look like the Death Drive we imagined. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KlHdFHD.gif[/img]

This is how the journey starts. No one saw the Zombie outbreak coming; it just hit, like an untamable wave all over the world, leaving everyone wondering and terrified. Angel already struggling with his mental health pretty much thought he was losing his mind as he watched the news and immediately goes looking for a pill to stop the madness attack he thinks he's having. 

It's been 2 years since the apocalypse started and the outside world looks nothing like before. Angel together with a kitten he sheltered during the outbreak decide to leave the old place in search of supplies. 



Without spoiling much, let's move on to our next feature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818348/d655f7688b4211e55793a4ccb04f1c209a7955b7.png[/img]

Our in-house tool for creating quests and dialogues is now fully functional and makes organizing the whole storyline a much easier task. Here's a peek at our very own Dialogue Editor.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Lfc8Pec.gif[/img]

[h2]Combat design overhaul[/h2]

This is the biggest change we've done since the announcement of Death Drive so far and it took a lot of effort to get it right, but we couldn't be happier with the final result! It was definitely worth it and I want to thank each one of you who participated in discussions and feedback.

Here's our final result!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/j6QlPja.gif[/img]

With the new style complete now, we're doing some final revisions to make sure each section of the game merges together well and also recreating existing combat animations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818348/3bfa14b8f0991fb6b96c5aacac1a939ff9635ca7.png[/img]

Finally, as we're leaving the pre-alpha stage we're looking forward to updating our page with some fresh new screenshots and gameplay footage!

[h3]Share your feedback![/h3]

Let us know what you think. We'd really love to hear your feedback. ❤

Stay tuned for more!

[i]We're trying to share smaller updates more frequently on our [url=https://twitter.com/shotxstudio]Twitter account[/url], so make sure you follow us! And also, you're more than welcome to join our 👉 [url=https://discord.com/invite/T9qv7sB]community on Discord[/url] 👈 and let us know what you think about Death Drive.[/i]

Stay safe!

notes.title: Devlog #5 - Journal, Quests & More!
notes.content:
Hey all, welcome back to our devlog! ❤️

It's been busy few weeks here at Shotx - working on new features and concepts, getting started on the story content and brainstorming some new ideas. We are already in love with Death Drive and seeing how eagerly our fans are waiting for its release is boosting that much needed motivation and enthusiasm!

[h2]Journal, quest system and objective tracking[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818348/4bb571d14815edc5ed6d19d23014563ea13a897c.gif[/img]

[i]Journal - keeping track of quests, jobs & contracts, reputation, statistics and catalogue.[/i]

One of the more important features remaining on our to-do list was a complete quest system and journal to keep track of all progress and objectives. With tons of both, main and side quests planned, as well as procedurally generated jobs and contracts, it was a real challenge to come up with a system, that would automatically track all these objectives in real-time and guide the player in the best way possible. Though, after some careful planning we managed to get everything working perfectly!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818348/0de3a0998e9f92d59daf8fa3c1c6059fb277f399.png[/img]

The journal also lists your current reputation with different factions and trading points, some useful statistics and a catalogue of many helpful tips. All of these elements are now complete and we're finally ready to move on with the story content.

[h2]Training grounds and card progression[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0z6h8lX.gif[/img]

[i]Training grounds in Sunny Village.[/i]

We've been working on the player progression with the combat cards and the way new cards are acquired. Some of the locations and settlements will contain a new interactive tile called Training Grounds that allows you to buy different cards. Each location will have their own unique cards to choose from, so if you're planning to become a collector you'll have to travel a lot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818348/24324365d4cc6938ab2a0d315b23a6d37466f4f7.png[/img]

[h3]Book of wisdom[/h3]

Another way to acquire new cards is by getting your hands on a book of wisdom. These books can be found by searching and looting different places. The rarity of these books also vary, and the less common the tome is, the higher the chance of getting more epic or even legendary cards!

[h2]Sneak peek at some new content[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Bo9I7Vr.gif[/img]

[i]New ground tiles.[/i]

We've also been busy creating new content and the time has come to finally share some sneak peeks! 😉

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bdD5EGY.gif[/img]

[i]New door types.[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/T4KuICc.gif[/img]

[i]Main menu - work in progress[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818348/685250cd2d885f238d571b4d400ad3375c814ec2.png[/img]

[i]We know you'll love him![/i]

[h3]Share your feedback![/h3]

And finally, let us know what you think. We'd really love to hear your feedback, especially since we're experimenting with a new art style for our combat scenes. Do you prefer the previous style or the new more realistic one?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818348/9f79406fecead5bc59e143bf7c1fe99581c9e63d.png[/img]

[i]New art style concept.[/i]

Stay tuned for more!

And also, you're more than welcome to join our 👉 [url=https://discord.com/invite/T9qv7sB]community on Discord[/url] 👈 and let us know what you think about Death Drive.[/i]
